top_signals.headline: Bank Indonesia Holds BI-Rate at 5.75% to Support Rupiah Stability
top_signals.impact: The central bank maintained its benchmark rate amid global uncertainty, balancing growth support with currency stability. Foreign reserves remain robust at $151.8B, providing FX intervention capacity.

top_signals.headline: JCI Index Resilient Above 7,200 as Foreign Flows Turn Positive
top_signals.impact: Jakarta Composite Index maintains strength driven by banking and consumer sectors. Net foreign buying resumed as EM sentiment improves on Fed pivot expectations. YTD performance +2.3%.

top_signals.headline: Indonesia Q3 GDP Grows 5.12% YoY, Beats Consensus Estimates
top_signals.impact: Economic expansion driven by household consumption (+4.9%) and fixed investment (+5.1%). Manufacturing PMI at 52.3 signals continued expansion. Full-year growth projected at 5.05-5.15%.

top_signals.headline: Federal Reserve Signals Potential December Rate Cut Amid Cooling Inflation
top_signals.impact: FOMC minutes suggest committee members see conditions for further easing. Core PCE trending toward 2.5% target. Markets pricing 65% probability of 25bp cut in December.

top_signals.headline: Fed's Goolsbee calls inflation report 'borderline disturbing' as central bank weighs more hikes
top_signals.impact: The consumer price index rose more than expected in October, raising alarm among Federal Reserve officials.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Rupiah Stabilizes at 15,850/USD on Trade Surplus
top_signals.impact: Currency finds support from continued trade surplus ($10.5B Q3) and BI intervention. Carry trade dynamics remain favorable vs USD. Key resistance at 16,000 level.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Banks Report Strong NIM Expansion in Q3 Results
top_signals.impact: Major banks (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI) posted 12-15% earnings growth with NIMs expanding to 5.2-5.8%. Loan growth accelerated to 11.5% YoY. NPL ratios stable at 2.1-2.4%.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 Approaches All-Time High on AI Optimism and Rate Cut Bets
top_signals.impact: Index trading near 6,000 level as tech sector leads. Magnificent 7 stocks contribute 60% of YTD gains. Earnings growth re-accelerating to +8% YoY in Q4.

top_signals.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls to 4.35% on Dovish Fed Outlook
top_signals.impact: Bond yields decline as markets reprice Fed trajectory. Real yields at +2.0% remain attractive for fixed income allocations. Duration positioning shifts to neutral.

top_signals.headline: Falling US Bond Futures Offer No Relief as Fed Hike Bets Grow
top_signals.impact: Derivatives trading suggests a retreat in US Treasuries is set to continue as faster-than-expected inflation data cement expectations for more aggressive interest-rate hikes from the Federal Reserve.

top_signals.headline: China Manufacturing PMI Expands to 51.5, Supporting EM Sentiment
top_signals.impact: Factory activity strengthens on stimulus measures and export recovery. Positive read-through for Asian supply chains and commodity demand. EM currencies rally.

top_signals.headline: Brent Crude Holds at $78/bbl as OPEC+ Maintains Production Discipline
top_signals.impact: Oil prices stabilize on balanced supply-demand outlook. OPEC+ compliance remains high at 95%. Inventory levels normalize. Range-bound trading expected near term.

top_signals.headline: JetBlue unveils new first-class seats to bring back profits
top_signals.impact: JetBlue gave reporters a look at its new first-class seats on Wednesday.

top_signals.headline: Feds arrest top official of healthcare company, alleging illegal drug importation
top_signals.impact: U.S. officials are accusing two top officials of a Canadian company of operating a scheme to illegally import prescription drugs, court records show.

top_signals.headline: JetBlue's CEO has pushed back on creditor fears and is betting on premium to return to profitability
top_signals.impact: JetBlue will give reporters a look at its new first class seats on Wednesday.

top_signals.headline: Stock Market Today: Tech Stocks Poised to Rise After CoreWeave Earnings
top_signals.impact: Latest market news.

top_signals.headline: OpenAI Third-Quarter Revenue Soars Nearly 50% to $10 Billion
top_signals.impact: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue hit $10 billion for the first time in the three months ending in September, according to people familiar with the matter, driven by strong demand for its latest artificial intelligence software.

top_signals.headline: Fed’s Paulson Says Gradual Tightening Seems Appropriate for Now
top_signals.impact: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia President Anna Paulson said she favors a gradual pace for interest-rate increases, adding that wage pressures have been limited and inflation expectations remain consistent with the central bank’s 2% target.

top_signals.headline: Fed’s Bowman Warns of Stock Correction If AI Bets Don’t Pan Out
top_signals.impact: Federal Reserve Governor Michelle Bowman said she sees a number of risks to economic activity from financial markets, including a sharp downturn in stock prices if returns on investments in artificial intelligence fall short of expectations.

top_signals.headline: Lucid misses Wall Street’s earnings expectations, expands loan from Saudi Arabia fund
top_signals.impact: The quarterly results are the first since Lucid CEO Silvio Napoli, who started leading the company in June, announced a restructuring plan.

top_signals.headline: Jensen and Lori Huang's Nvidia fortune is jointly controlled. How that makes things complicated now that he's resigned
top_signals.impact: Jensen Huang’s $140 billion stake in Nvidia is largely held by trusts co-owned with his wife, Lori, creating added uncertainty for his financial future.

top_signals.headline: Disney's 'Star Wars' is coming to Cosm domes ahead of 50th anniversary as part of multiyear film deal
top_signals.impact: Cosm has secured a new studio partnership with Disney that will bring "Star Wars: A New Hope" to its domes as part of a multiyear, multifilm collaboration.

top_signals.headline: Unions helped Democrats win big in 2026. Now they want action
top_signals.impact: Unions spent millions of dollars and mobilized thousands of members to get out the vote for Democrats in the midterm election. Now they want to see action.

top_signals.headline: Scout Motors has 212,000 vehicle reservations as $2 billion South Carolina plant nears completion
top_signals.impact: Scout Motors has roughly 212,000 reservations for its Terra pickup and Traveler SUV, CEO Scott Keogh told CNBC.
